import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import json
import pathlib


def binding(mode):
    label = 'binding-'+mode
    with fixture_directory() as temp:
        fixture = pathlib.Path(temp)
        keys, objects = seed(fixture, label, two_entries=True)
        requested = '/fixture/artifacts/v3/packs/fixture/'+keys[0]+'.tar.zst'
        substitute = '/fixture/artifacts/v3/packs/fixture/'+keys[1]+'.tar.zst'
        if mode == 'swap':
            objects[requested] = objects[substitute]
        elif mode == 'corrupt':
            objects[requested] = b'not a valid zstd tar pack'
        print('requested_key:', keys[0], 'substitute_key:', keys[1], 'mode:', mode, flush=True)
        (fixture/'fixture.rs').write_text('pub fn value() -> u32 { 11 }\n')
        for output in (fixture/'out').iterdir():
            output.unlink()
        with Endpoint(objects) as remote:
            base, env = configure(fixture, 'cold', endpoint=remote.url)
            with daemon(base, env, label+'.cold'):
                run(compiler_args(fixture), env, fixture)
                meta_path = base/'cache'/'store'/keys[0]/'meta.json'
                meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_text()) if meta_path.exists() else None
                print('imported_metadata_key:', meta['cache_key'] if meta else None,
                      'requested_committed:', committed(base, keys[0]), flush=True)
                assert any(r['path'] == requested and r['status'] == 200 for r in remote.requests), 'EXACT_GET_NOT_EXERCISED'
                consumer = fixture/'consumer.rs'
                consumer.write_text('fn main(){println!("{}", fixture::value());}\n')
                run([RUSTC, '--extern', 'fixture='+str(fixture/'out'/'libfixture-audit.rlib'),
                     str(consumer), '-o', str(fixture/'consumer')], env, fixture)
                observed = run([str(fixture/'consumer')], env, fixture).stdout.decode().strip()
                print('expected_value: 11 observed_value:', observed, flush=True)
                assert observed == '11', 'WRONG_REMOTE_BINDING: source returns 11 but restored valid artifact returns '+observed
                if mode == 'valid':
                    assert meta and meta['cache_key'] == keys[0], 'VALID_CONTROL_NOT_IMPORTED'
        print('PASS:', label, flush=True)


def check(base, key, shard=False):
    cache = base/('shard' if shard else 'cache')
    request = {'key': key, 'crate_name': 'fixture', 'entry_dir': str(cache/'store'/key),
               'deadline_ms': 3000}
    if shard:
        request['shard_dir'] = str(cache)
    return request


def shards(mode):
    label = 'shards-'+mode
    with fixture_directory() as temp:
        fixture = pathlib.Path(temp)
        keys, objects = seed(fixture, label)
        key = keys[0]
        with Endpoint(objects, delay=.15) as remote:
            base, env = configure(fixture, 'cold', endpoint=remote.url, volumes=True)
            with daemon(base, env, label+'.cold'):
                checks = [check(base, key), check(base, key, shard=(mode != 'same-store'))]
                if mode == 'reverse':
                    checks.reverse()
                if mode == 'sequential':
                    results = [ipc(env, {'remote_check': item}) for item in checks]
                elif mode == 'sockets':
                    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
                        jobs = [pool.submit(ipc, env, {'remote_check': item}) for item in checks]
                        results = [job.result(timeout=10) for job in jobs]
                else:
                    reply = ipc(env, {'batch_remote_check': {'checks': checks}})
                    assert reply.get('ok') is True, 'BATCH_REQUEST_FAILED: '+json.dumps(reply)
                    results = reply['batch_results']
                print('checks:', json.dumps(checks, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
                print('results:', json.dumps(results, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
                main_hit, shard_hit = committed(base, key), committed(base, key, shard=True)
                print('main_committed:', main_hit, 'shard_committed:', shard_hit, flush=True)
                assert len(results) == 2 and all(r.get('ok') is True and r.get('found') is True for r in results), 'GENERATED_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND'
                assert main_hit and (mode == 'same-store' or shard_hit), 'SHARD_SINGLEFLIGHT_FALSE_HIT: both requests report found but a requested store has no committed entry'
        print('PASS:', label, flush=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('probe', choices=['binding', 'shards'])
    parser.add_argument('mode')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    choices = {'binding': ['valid', 'swap', 'corrupt'],
               'shards': ['sequential', 'concurrent', 'reverse', 'same-store', 'sockets']}
    assert args.mode in choices[args.probe], choices
    print('probe:', args.probe, 'mode:', args.mode, 'baseline:', BIN, flush=True)
    {'binding': binding, 'shards': shards}[args.probe](args.mode)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

            ('true' if endpoint else 'false')+'\n')
    if volumes:
        text += '[cache.volumes]\n'+json.dumps(str(fixture/'volume'))+' = '+json.dumps(str(base/'shard'))+'\n'
    if endpoint:
        text += '[cache.remote]\ntype = "s3"\nbucket = "fixture"\nprefix = "artifacts"\nendpoint = '+json.dumps(endpoint)+'\nregion = "us-east-1"\n'
    else:
        text += '[cache.remote]\ntype = "filesystem"\npath = '+json.dumps(str(fixture/'remote'))+'\nprefix = "artifacts"\n'
    cfg.write_text(text)
    return base, fixture_env(base, cfg, sock)


def run(args, env, cwd):
    result = subprocess.run(args, env=env, cwd=cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                            stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=45)
    print('argv:', json.dumps(args), 'cwd:', str(cwd), 'exit:', result.returncode, flush=True)
    if result.stdout:
        print('stdout:', result.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), flush=True)
    if result.stderr:
        print('stderr:', result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'), flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0, 'FIXTURE_COMMAND_FAILED: '+repr(args)
    return result


def ipc(env, request):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX) as client:
        client.settimeout(10)
        client.connect(env['KACHE_SOCKET_PATH'])
        client.sendall((json.dumps(request)+'\n').encode())
        line = client.makefile('rb').readline()
        assert line, 'EMPTY_DAEMON_REPLY'
        return json.loads(line)


@contextlib.contextmanager
def daemon(base, env, log_name):
    log_path = ROOT/(log_name+'.daemon.log')
    with log_path.open('wb') as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen([BIN, 'daemon', 'run'], env=env, cwd=base,
                                   stdout=log, stderr=log)
        print('daemon_argv:', json.dumps([BIN, 'daemon', 'run']), 'env:', json.dumps(env, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
        try:
            for _ in range(250):
                if pathlib.Path(env['KACHE_SOCKET_PATH']).exists():
                    break
                assert process.poll() is None, 'DAEMON_EXITED: '+log_path.read_text()
                time.sleep(.02)
            else:
                raise AssertionError('DAEMON_START_TIMEOUT')
            reply = ipc(env, {'stats': {'include_entries': False, 'sort_by': None, 'event_hours': None}})
            eff = reply['stats']['effective_config']
            for field, var in [('cache_dir', 'KACHE_CACHE_DIR'), ('runtime_dir', 'KACHE_RUNTIME_DIR'),
                               ('config_path', 'KACHE_CONFIG'), ('socket_path', 'KACHE_SOCKET_PATH')]:
                assert eff[field] == env[var], ('RESOLVED_PATH_MISMATCH', field, eff[field], env[var])
            assert eff['remote_error'] is None and eff['remote_description'], eff
            print('asserted_effective_config:', json.dumps(eff, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
            yield
        finally:
            if process.poll() is None:
                try:
                    print('shutdown_reply:', ipc(env, 'shutdown'), flush=True)
                except (OSError, ValueError, AssertionError) as error:
                    print('shutdown_error:', repr(error), flush=True)
                try:
                    process.wait(timeout=15)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    process.terminate()
                    process.wait(timeout=10)
            print('daemon_exit:', process.returncode, flush=True)
            for artifact in ROOT.glob(pathlib.Path(env['KACHE_SOCKET_PATH']).name+'*'):
                artifact.unlink(missing_ok=True)


class Endpoint:
    """Loopback S3 object GET double preserves the real transport and extraction seam."""
    def __init__(self, objects, delay=0):
        self.objects, self.delay, self.requests = objects, delay, []
        owner = self
        class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
            def do_GET(self):
                key = self.path.split('?', 1)[0]
                payload = owner.objects.get(key)
                owner.requests.append({'path': key, 'status': 200 if payload is not None else 404,
                                       'bytes': len(payload) if payload is not None else 0})
                if owner.delay:
                    time.sleep(owner.delay)
                self.send_response(200 if payload is not None else 404)
                self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(payload) if payload is not None else 0))
                self.send_header('ETag', '"fixture-object"')
                self.end_headers()
                if payload is not None:
                    self.wfile.write(payload)
            def log_message(self, format, *args):
                print('loopback_http:', format % args, flush=True)
        self.server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 0), Handler)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.url = 'http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.server.server_port)
    def __enter__(self):
        self.thread.start()
        return self
    def __exit__(self, *args):
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join()
        print('endpoint_requests:', json.dumps(self.requests, sort_keys=True), flush=True)


def compiler_args(fixture):
    return [BIN, RUSTC, '--crate-name', 'fixture', '--crate-type', 'rlib',
            '--emit', 'link,dep-info', '-C', 'metadata=audit', '-C', 'extra-filename=-audit',
            '--out-dir', str(fixture/'out'), str(fixture/'fixture.rs')]


def seed(fixture, log_name, two_entries=False):
    for directory in ['remote', 'out', 'volume']:
        (fixture/directory).mkdir()
    args = compiler_args(fixture)
    base, env = configure(fixture, 'seed')
    keys = []
    with daemon(base, env, log_name+'.seed'):
        for value in ([11, 29] if two_entries else [11]):
            (fixture/'fixture.rs').write_text('pub fn value() -> u32 { '+str(value)+' }\n')
            run(args, env, fixture)
            metas = list((base/'cache'/'store').glob('*/meta.json'))
            new = [p for p in metas if json.loads(p.read_text())['cache_key'] not in keys]
            assert len(new) == 1, 'SEED_NOT_CACHED_DISTINCTLY'
            key = json.loads(new[0].read_text())['cache_key']
            keys.append(key)
            run([BIN, 'sync', '--push'], env, fixture)
    objects = {}
    for key in keys:
        file = fixture/'remote'/'artifacts'/'v3'/'packs'/'fixture'/(key+'.tar.zst')
        assert file.is_file(), 'SEED_PACK_MISSING: '+str(file)
        payload = file.read_bytes()
        objects['/fixture/artifacts/v3/packs/fixture/'+key+'.tar.zst'] = payload
        print('seed_pack:', key, 'bytes:', len(payload), 'sha256:', hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), flush=True)
    return keys, objects


def committed(base, key, shard=False):
    cache = base/('shard' if shard else 'cache')
    db = cache/'index.db'
    if not db.exists():
        return False
    with sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(db)+'?mode=ro', uri=True) as connection:
        row = connection.execute('SELECT committed FROM entries WHERE cache_key=?', (key,)).fetchone()
        return row is not None and row[0] == 1


def fixture_directory():
    return tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='f-', dir=ROOT)

import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import json
import pathlib
from probe_support import (BIN, ROOT, RUSTC, Endpoint, committed, compiler_args,
                           configure, daemon, fixture_directory, ipc, run, seed)


def binding(mode):
    label = 'binding-'+mode
    with fixture_directory() as temp:
        fixture = pathlib.Path(temp)
        keys, objects = seed(fixture, label, two_entries=True)
        requested = '/fixture/artifacts/v3/packs/fixture/'+keys[0]+'.tar.zst'
        substitute = '/fixture/artifacts/v3/packs/fixture/'+keys[1]+'.tar.zst'
        if mode == 'swap':
            objects[requested] = objects[substitute]
        elif mode == 'corrupt':
            objects[requested] = b'not a valid zstd tar pack'
        print('requested_key:', keys[0], 'substitute_key:', keys[1], 'mode:', mode, flush=True)
        (fixture/'fixture.rs').write_text('pub fn value() -> u32 { 11 }\n')
        for output in (fixture/'out').iterdir():
            output.unlink()
        with Endpoint(objects) as remote:
            base, env = configure(fixture, 'cold', endpoint=remote.url)
            with daemon(base, env, label+'.cold'):
                run(compiler_args(fixture), env, fixture)
                meta_path = base/'cache'/'store'/keys[0]/'meta.json'
                meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_text()) if meta_path.exists() else None
                print('imported_metadata_key:', meta['cache_key'] if meta else None,
                      'requested_committed:', committed(base, keys[0]), flush=True)
                assert any(r['path'] == requested and r['status'] == 200 for r in remote.requests), 'EXACT_GET_NOT_EXERCISED'
                consumer = fixture/'consumer.rs'
                consumer.write_text('fn main(){println!("{}", fixture::value());}\n')
                run([RUSTC, '--extern', 'fixture='+str(fixture/'out'/'libfixture-audit.rlib'),
                     str(consumer), '-o', str(fixture/'consumer')], env, fixture)
                observed = run([str(fixture/'consumer')], env, fixture).stdout.decode().strip()
                print('expected_value: 11 observed_value:', observed, flush=True)
                assert observed == '11', 'WRONG_REMOTE_BINDING: source returns 11 but restored valid artifact returns '+observed
                if mode == 'valid':
                    assert meta and meta['cache_key'] == keys[0], 'VALID_CONTROL_NOT_IMPORTED'
        print('PASS:', label, flush=True)


def check(base, key, shard=False):
    cache = base/('shard' if shard else 'cache')
    request = {'key': key, 'crate_name': 'fixture', 'entry_dir': str(cache/'store'/key),
               'deadline_ms': 3000}
    if shard:
        request['shard_dir'] = str(cache)
    return request


def shards(mode):
    label = 'shards-'+mode
    with fixture_directory() as temp:
        fixture = pathlib.Path(temp)
        keys, objects = seed(fixture, label)
        key = keys[0]
        with Endpoint(objects, delay=.15) as remote:
            base, env = configure(fixture, 'cold', endpoint=remote.url, volumes=True)
            with daemon(base, env, label+'.cold'):
                checks = [check(base, key), check(base, key, shard=(mode != 'same-store'))]
                if mode == 'reverse':
                    checks.reverse()
                if mode == 'sequential':
                    results = [ipc(env, {'remote_check': item}) for item in checks]
                elif mode == 'sockets':
                    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
                        jobs = [pool.submit(ipc, env, {'remote_check': item}) for item in checks]
                        results = [job.result(timeout=10) for job in jobs]
                else:
                    reply = ipc(env, {'batch_remote_check': {'checks': checks}})
                    assert reply.get('ok') is True, 'BATCH_REQUEST_FAILED: '+json.dumps(reply)
                    results = reply['batch_results']
                print('checks:', json.dumps(checks, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
                print('results:', json.dumps(results, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
                main_hit, shard_hit = committed(base, key), committed(base, key, shard=True)
                print('main_committed:', main_hit, 'shard_committed:', shard_hit, flush=True)
                assert len(results) == 2 and all(r.get('ok') is True and r.get('found') is True for r in results), 'GENERATED_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND'
                assert main_hit and (mode == 'same-store' or shard_hit), 'SHARD_SINGLEFLIGHT_FALSE_HIT: both requests report found but a requested store has no committed entry'
        print('PASS:', label, flush=True)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('probe', choices=['binding', 'shards'])
    parser.add_argument('mode')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    choices = {'binding': ['valid', 'swap', 'corrupt'],
               'shards': ['sequential', 'concurrent', 'reverse', 'same-store', 'sockets']}
    assert args.mode in choices[args.probe], choices
    print('probe:', args.probe, 'mode:', args.mode, 'baseline:', BIN, flush=True)
    {'binding': binding, 'shards': shards}[args.probe](args.mode)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
